current_state.zh: Hyperliquid Labs confirmed its headquarters are in Singapore, while the Monetary Authority of Singapore said it does not consider Hyperliquid within its regulatory purview because of the protocol's decentralized nature, and that it is unaware of Hyperliquid being regulated in any major jurisdiction.
